info.name: KartuNamaDigital REST API - Local
info.description: Node.js + Express REST API collection. Administrative table CRUD requires a super-admin session, data.read/data.manage permissions, and CSRF for mutations.

item.name: Starter
item.description: Create attempts SMTP delivery immediately. emailSent means SMTP accepted, not inbox delivery. Access exchanges the email fragment token once; keep the cookie jar enabled.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 201) { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.collectionVariables.set('starterPublicId', d.publicId); pm.collectionVariables.set('starterSlug', d.slug); pm.test('Starter slug is exactly seven ASCII letters', () => pm.expect(d.slug).to.match(/^[A-Za-z]{7}$/)); pm.test('Email status is explicit', () => pm.expect(d.emailSent).to.be.a('boolean')); }
if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.test('Starter has no WhatsApp CTA', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.whatsappUrl).to.eql(null));
